description: Preview or reclaim abandoned session-ledger event-text blobs in the shared filesystem store. Operator principal required. The default confirm=false returns counts without deleting files, updating metadata or opening a lock file. confirm=true irreversibly deletes only session_ledger blobs whose kind is event_content_text, creation time is older than one hour, and content_blob_id is referenced by no event, including soft-deleted events. Metadata, including tombstones, is keyset-paged in groups of 100; event existence reads return at most one row. Each confirmed classification and deletion holds the importer's cross-process file guard for one blob. A five-second lock timeout increments skipped_locked; unreadable or ambiguous rows increment ambiguous_count and remain untouched. Registered calls return job_id and queued status; read the job for confirmed, scanned_count, candidate_count, candidate_bytes, deleted_count, deleted_bytes, unlinked_after_tombstone, failed_count, ambiguous_count, skipped_locked and excluded_count. Metadata is retired before file unlink. A metadata retirement failure preserves the readable file; an unlink failure leaves retired metadata and leftover bytes. Either failure increments failed_count and stops with partial counts, never deletion success. Provider metadata tombstones remain as history and are excluded from importer hash reuse. A later separately confirmed run can unlink a tombstoned leftover file under the same age/kind/namespace/reference selector and guard, without another metadata write; this increments unlinked_after_tombstone instead of deleted_count. Terminal metadata with no remaining file is excluded from candidates. This does not repair importers or reclaim exports, attachments or assets.
embedding_description: Measure and remove abandoned event text that fills session-ledger blob storage. Preview orphan count and bytes first, then explicitly confirm deletion of unreferenced text older than an hour while preserving assets, attachments and referenced history.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job receipt with job_id and status; the completed job contains reclaim counts.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report preview count and bytes before confirmation. For completed confirmed work, distinguish newly deleted counts from unlinked_after_tombstone recovery, failed_count, ambiguous rows and lock skips. A queued receipt does not mean any blob was deleted.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retrieve the exact submitted job before considering further work. The manager shows the preview counts to the operator before issuing confirm=true. Do not automatically retry a failed deletion. Run only after every overlapping service process has the shared guard implementation; an older unguarded importer cannot participate in the lock. No source-disable gate applies.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read metadata and event references through typed state/provider APIs, then delete a classified blob only under the shared filesystem lock when explicitly confirmed.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Authorization failure means the trusted caller is not an operator. Missing filesystem root means this store does not support local reclaim. Enumeration or deletion failures stop the job; deletion errors include partial counts. Individual classification failures leave their blobs untouched and increment ambiguous_count.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect the exact job and partial counts, including failed_count. Correct the reported storage or state failure before a separately requested run. A retired metadata row with leftover bytes is eligible only for unlink recovery under the same confirmed selector and guard, counted as unlinked_after_tombstone; recovery never writes metadata again. Review skipped_locked and ambiguous_count; neither category is deletion success. Never substitute a remote download-cache path for the provider shared root.
